provenance: Curated domain configuration (agent-drafted, human review pending). Areas derived from the domain definition of automobile engineering, NOT from benchmark questions.

requirement_areas.name: Engine & power generation
requirement_areas.description: Internal and external combustion engines for vehicles: Otto and Diesel cycles, two-stroke and four-stroke operation, engine architecture (cylinders, pistons, crankshaft, valvetrain), rotary engines, turbocharging and supercharging, fuel systems and fuel injection, engine efficiency and emissions.

requirement_areas.name: Transmission & drivetrain
requirement_areas.description: Power transmission from engine to wheels: manual and automatic gearboxes, dual-clutch and continuously variable transmissions, torque converters, gear ratios, differentials, driveshafts, drive layouts (FWD, RWD, AWD), final drive.

requirement_areas.name: Braking systems
requirement_areas.description: Vehicle braking: friction brakes (disc and drum), hydraulic circuits, brake pads and rotors, anti-lock braking systems, brake force distribution, engine braking, regenerative braking interaction.

requirement_areas.name: Steering systems
requirement_areas.description: Directional control: steering geometry (Ackermann, camber, caster, toe), rack and pinion, recirculating ball, hydraulic and electric power steering, speed-sensitive assistance, four-wheel steering.

requirement_areas.name: Suspension & ride
requirement_areas.description: Wheels, tires, and suspension: springs, dampers, MacPherson strut, double wishbone, multi-link, anti-roll bars, unsprung mass, ride rate, roll rate, wheel alignment, tire construction and dynamics.

requirement_areas.name: Chassis & body structure
requirement_areas.description: Vehicle structures: ladder frame, body-on-frame, unibody/monocoque construction, subframes, crumple zones, crashworthiness, vehicle architecture, platform design, weight distribution.

requirement_areas.name: Vehicle dynamics & handling
requirement_areas.description: Motion and control of the complete vehicle: longitudinal and lateral dynamics, understeer/oversteer, weight transfer, slip angles, roll and pitch, ride quality, handling balance, simulation models.

requirement_areas.name: Electric vehicles & electrification
requirement_areas.description: Electric and hybrid propulsion: battery electric vehicles, traction batteries and battery management, electric motors, power electronics and inverters, charging systems and infrastructure, hybridization, range and efficiency.

requirement_areas.name: Automobile fundamentals & general systems
requirement_areas.description: General automobile engineering: vehicle classification and layout, major component systems, history and development of the automobile, safety systems, fuels, lubrication, cooling, electrical systems, maintenance engineering.
